lines.text: The list runs from Adam down to Noah, whose sons were Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Cush fathered Nimrod, and Eber's son Peleg was named that because in his days the earth was divided.
The line from Shem runs through Eber and Terah to Abraham, whose sons were Isaac and Ishmael.
Ishmael's firstborn was Nebaioth, and Isaac's sons were Esau and Jacob, and Eliphaz had a son named Amalek by Timna.
Before any king reigned over the Egyptians, Bela reigned in Edom, and the chiefs of Edom were listed.
